name: @capgo/capacitor-age-range
description: Cross-platform age range detection. Google Play Age Signals on Android, Apple DeclaredAgeRange on iOS.
author: Martin Donadieu <martin@capgo.app>

scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run docgen && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.example:build: bun run build && cd example-app && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.example-app:prepare:android: CAPGO_MAESTRO_CI=1 bun run build && cd example-app && CAPGO_MAESTRO_CI=1 bun install --frozen-lockfile && CAPGO_MAESTRO_CI=1 bun run build && (test -d android || bunx cap add android) && CAPGO_MAESTRO_CI=1 bunx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew app:assembleDebug
scripts.maestro:test:android:e2e: export MAESTRO_DRIVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=180000 MAESTRO_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 && sh ./scripts/prepare-android-maestro-device.sh && sh ./scripts/install-android-apk-with-retry.sh example-app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && sh ./scripts/start-android-maestro-app.sh app.capgo.age.range app.capgo.age.range/.MainActivity && $HOME/.maestro/bin/maestro test .maestro/age-range-android-e2e.yaml
scripts.maestro:test:android:default-never: export MAESTRO_DRIVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=180000 MAESTRO_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 && sh ./scripts/prepare-android-maestro-device.sh && sh ./scripts/install-android-apk-with-retry.sh example-app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && sh ./scripts/start-android-maestro-app.sh app.capgo.age.range app.capgo.age.range/.MainActivity && $HOME/.maestro/bin/maestro test .maestro/age-range-default-android.yaml
scripts.maestro:test:android:when-mandatory: export MAESTRO_DRIVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=180000 MAESTRO_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 && sh ./scripts/prepare-android-maestro-device.sh && sh ./scripts/install-android-apk-with-retry.sh example-app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && sh ./scripts/start-android-maestro-app.sh app.capgo.age.range app.capgo.age.range/.MainActivity && $HOME/.maestro/bin/maestro test .maestro/age-range-when-mandatory-android.yaml
